claims.claim_text: Corporal Rios arrived at the residence first.
I arrived approximately one minute later and parked approximately 200 to 300 feet south of the condominium.
Corporal Rios stood in the walkway approximately 40 feet east of the subject, using his flashlight to illuminate the subject.
Corporal Rios asked the subject who he was and commanded him to come out of the enclosed area.
I was concerned for the reporting party and her two young children and decided to deploy my Taser.
I deployed my Taser toward the subject, striking him in the back.
I saw the subject point the gun directly in Corporal Rios's direction. Believing Corporal Rios was about to be shot in the head, I pointed my gun at the subject and fired.
Corporal Rios then dropped his Taser, drew his duty handgun, and fired nine rounds at the subject.
Officer Pistilli removed the gun from the subject's immediate reach and handcuffed the subject.
Corporal Rios then placed a tourniquet on the subject's left upper thigh area.
The gun was registered to the subject's father.
The subject fell into the enclosed area onto his left side and then flat on his back.
Corporal Rios was about three feet behind and to the left of me.
He had a beverage can in his right hand.
